sentences.en: And there are so many of them.
sentences.zh: 而且他们有那么多人。

sentences.en: And what is, in his mind, what happens when he reaches the U.S.?
sentences.zh: 在他心里，他觉得到了美国会发生什么？

sentences.en: And how does this change his circumstances?
sentences.zh: 这又将如何改变他的处境？

sentences.en: So, the majority of people I've interviewed feel that it's always hard to get across the border.
sentences.zh: 所以，我采访过的大多数人都觉得，过境总是很难的。

sentences.en: And this will just make it easier for them to get through Mexico and get to the border.
sentences.zh: 而这只会让他们更容易穿过墨西哥并到达边境。

sentences.en: I don't think they're thinking necessarily about what's going to happen when they arrive.
sentences.zh: 我觉得他们不一定在考虑到达后会发生什么。

sentences.en: But he clearly has it in his head that something good happens or else he wouldn't be taking this journey.
sentences.zh: 但他脑子里显然认定会有好事发生，否则他也不会踏上这段旅程。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I think people really do feel that this caravan has given them the hope that they may actually make it.
sentences.zh: 我觉得大家确实觉得这个大篷车队伍给他们带来了真的能成功的希望。

sentences.en: I think having crossed the border into Mexico and not having been successfully turned back and then being given food and water and used clothes and really being
sentences.zh: 我想，在越过边境进入墨西哥后没有被成功遣返，接着又得到了食物、水和旧衣服，并且真的受到了

sentences.en: welcomed here has given them the hope, as unrealistic as it might seem, that the same thing might happen when they reach the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这里的欢迎，这让他们产生了一种希望——尽管看起来可能不太现实——即他们到达美国时也可能会发生同样的事情。

sentences.en: A lot of people are drawing that comparison, saying, you know, we made it across the border into Mexico, we can make it across the border into the U.S.
sentences.zh: 很多人都在做这样的比较，心想，你知道的，我们成功跨越边境进入了墨西哥，我们也能跨越边境进入美国。

sentences.en: Yesterday was an interesting turning point.
sentences.zh: 昨天是一个有趣的转折点。

sentences.en: Morale was high after people were able to get into
sentences.zh: 在人们得以进入

sentences.en: Mexico.
sentences.zh: 墨西哥之后，士气高涨。

sentences.en: And they had done this long march from Hidalgo to Tapachula, the first leg of the trip.
sentences.zh: 他们完成了从伊达尔戈到塔帕丘拉的长途跋涉，这是行程的第一阶段。

sentences.en: And things went relatively well.
sentences.zh: 一切都算顺利。

sentences.en: And then it was the second leg of their Mexican journey,
sentences.zh: 然后是他们墨西哥之旅的第二阶段，

sentences.en: Tapachula to Wixla.
sentences.zh: 从塔帕丘拉到维克斯拉。

sentences.en: And they all set out with a lot of energy and they were piling into trucks and walking.
sentences.zh: 他们都带着饱满的精力出发了，挤上卡车，步行前进。

sentences.en: And there was a young man, 21 years old, Melvin.
sentences.zh: 有个21岁的年轻小伙子叫梅尔文。

sentences.en: He was on a truck, which I gather was quite crowded.
sentences.zh: 他坐在一辆卡车上，据我了解，车上挤满了人。

sentences.en: And he fell off the back and he was killed.
sentences.zh: 结果他从后车厢摔了下去，不幸身亡。

sentences.en: And traffic sort of stopped.
sentences.zh: 交通有点停滞了。

sentences.en: The police were there.
sentences.zh: 警察赶到了现场。

sentences.en: The Human Rights Commission workers were there.
sentences.zh: 人权委员会的工作人员也到了。

sentences.en: And the next day, the newspapers said the first death of the migrant caravan.
sentences.zh: 第二天，报纸上写着：移民大篷车队伍的首起死亡事件。

sentences.en: It's hard to know if that's the first death, but that's the first documented case of someone dying on the caravan.
sentences.zh: 很难说这是否真的是第一起死亡事件，但这确实是有记录以来大篷车队伍中首起人员死亡的案例。

sentences.en: And I think it was the first time that the sort of real danger came into sight for a lot of people.
sentences.zh: 我想这也是很多人第一次真正看到了切实的危险。

sentences.en: And the police were there and the authorities were there.
sentences.zh: 警察和当局都在场。

sentences.en: And so I think that all along the literally all along the highway, people were hearing about what had happened.
sentences.zh: 所以我觉得，一路上，真的可以说是沿途的整条高速公路上，人们都在议论发生的事情。

sentences.en: And then they woke up to seeing the news on the front page of a newspaper called
sentences.zh: 然后他们醒来，在一家名为

sentences.en: El Diario Sur.
sentences.zh: 《南方日报》的报纸头版上看到了这条新闻。

sentences.en: This is the president's tweet.
sentences.zh: 这是总统的推文。

sentences.en: He says, sadly, it looks like Mexico's police and military are unable to stop the caravan heading to the southern border of the United States.
sentences.zh: 他说，可悲的是，看起来墨西哥的警察和军队无法阻止前往美国南部边境的大篷车队伍。

sentences.en: Criminals and unknown Middle Easterners are mixed in.
sentences.zh: 罪犯和不明身份的中东人混杂其中。

sentences.en: I have alerted Border Patrol and military that this is a natural national emergie.
sentences.zh: 我已经警告边境巡逻队和军方，这是一场自然国家紧急事件。

sentences.en: I guess he meant emergency.
sentences.zh: 我猜他是想说紧急状态。

sentences.en: Emergie must change laws.
sentences.zh: 紧急状态必须修改法律。

sentences.en: But we're going to call it the Democrat Party.
sentences.zh: 但我们要称之为民主党。

sentences.en: And it's openly inviting millions of illegal aliens to break our laws, violate our borders, and overwhelm our nation.
sentences.zh: 它公开邀请数百万非法外国人触犯我们的法律、践踏我们的边境并压垮我们的国家。

sentences.en: The Democrats want caravans.
sentences.zh: 民主党人想要大篷车。

sentences.en: They like the caravans.
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢大篷车。

sentences.en: A lot of people say, I wonder who started that caravan.
sentences.zh: 很多人说，我真想知道是谁发起了那个大篷车队伍。

sentences.en: Here, you would never know that Trump and all the tweets even existed.
sentences.zh: 在这里，你根本不会觉得特朗普和所有的推特曾经存在过。

sentences.en: Maritza Isabel García.

sentences.en: Gracias.
sentences.zh: Gracias.

sentences.en: They just know that he doesn't want them.
sentences.zh: 他们只知道特朗普不欢迎他们。

sentences.en: What many people told me is that all they know is that Trump doesn't want us or Trump doesn't like us or Trump doesn't love us.
sentences.zh: 许多人告诉我，他们只知道特朗普不想要我们，或者特朗普不喜欢我们，或者特朗普不爱我们。

sentences.en: But they are not aware of the day by day how things are playing out.
sentences.zh: 但他们并不知道事情每天是如何发展的。

sentences.en: I think one, maybe one in 10, knows that there are midterm elections coming up at all.
sentences.zh: 我想大概十个人里有一个人知道将要举行中期选举。

sentences.en: What a number of people have told me is that they feel sadness, tristeza, that they feel that any humane politician would see what they were going through and let them in.
sentences.zh: 许多人告诉我，他们感到悲伤（tristeza），他们觉得任何有同情心的政治家看到他们的遭遇都会让他们进来。

sentences.en: So that may seem wild as a proposition, but that's what I'm hearing from people on the ground.
sentences.zh: 所以这个想法听起来可能有点疯狂，但这就是我在实地听到人们说的。

sentences.en: And people are reacting to their own local politics in terms of the timing of this precise caravan.
sentences.zh: 人们是根据他们自己的地方政治来对这个确切的大篷车队伍的时机作出反应的。

sentences.en: It doesn't seem to have dovetailed with, you know, political events in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它似乎并没有与美国的政治事件相吻合。

sentences.en: Annie, I'm struck that despite what people in this caravan are telling you, that they are not
sentences.zh: 安妮，我感到震惊的是，尽管这个大篷车队伍里的人告诉你，他们并

sentences.en: that aware of what's going on in the midterm elections, that the timing here means that they are inevitably going to be used to animate the political forces in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 太了解中期选举正在发生什么，但这里的时机意味着，他们不可避免地会被用来调动美国那些对他们的诉求

sentences.en: who are the least
sentences.zh: 最缺乏

sentences.en: sympathetic to their cause.
sentences.zh: 同情心的政治力量。

sentences.en: And that we're in a moment where who gets animated politically
sentences.zh: 而且我们正处于这样一个时刻：谁在政治上被调动起来

sentences.en: matters a great deal because it dictates who's going to show up at the polls, who's going to be elected, and what our immigration policies are going to look like.
sentences.zh: 至关重要，因为它决定了谁会去投票站投票，谁会被选举产生，以及我们的移民政策将会是什么样子。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, I would say that they're playing into the hands.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我要说的是，他们正中对方下怀。

sentences.en: This is almost felt to Republicans, to Trump supporters, possibly even to the president himself as something of a
sentences.zh: 对共和党人、特朗普的支持者，甚至可能对总统本人来说，这几乎被认为是一种

sentences.en: political gift, a way to really stir up or mobilize the conservative base, people who are worried about
sentences.zh: 政治大礼，是真正激起或动员保守派基层力量的一种方式，那些担心

sentences.en: open borders, who want that wall to be built, that that was a way to sort of resurrect that message.
sentences.zh: 开放边境、想要修建那堵墙的人，认为这是复活那种信息的途径。

sentences.en: It's almost like this kind of colossal political accident, but that they managed to capture America's
sentences.zh: 这几乎就像是一场巨大的政治意外，但他们竟然在这些已经关乎国家安全问题的极其重要的选举前两周，成功吸引了美国人的

sentences.en: imagination two weeks before these incredibly important elections that are already about questions of national security.
sentences.zh: 关注。

sentences.en: Yeah, it's kind of incredible because at this crucial moment, this really large group of people
sentences.zh: 是的，这有点不可思议，因为在这个关键时刻，这群规模庞大的群体

sentences.en: has almost materialized as if to fulfill the political imagination, not just of Trump supporters,
sentences.zh: 几乎凭空出现，仿佛满足了政治想象，不仅是特朗普支持者的想象，

sentences.en: but also liberal progressive Americans who can point at nursing mothers sitting on cardboard boxes and
sentences.zh: 还有自由派进步主义美国人的想象，他们可以指着坐在硬纸板箱上的哺乳母亲，

sentences.en: the image of a migrant that isn't the MS-13 gang member that Trump has portrayed migrants to be.
sentences.zh: 以及移民的形象——那不是特朗普所描绘的MS-13帮派成员的移民形象。

sentences.en: So this group, they each have their own story, but they have all played into the hands of the
sentences.zh: 所以这个群体，他们每个人都有自己的故事，但他们都以一种我不知道他们是否能理解的方式，

sentences.en: political reality of the political reality of the moment in a way that I don't know whether they'll ever understand.
sentences.zh: 顺应了当时政治现实的需求。

sentences.en: I hope that's not condescending, but I think the only way they will understand

sentences.en: is if they make it to the border and see what awaits them, because it's so abstract from this distance.
sentences.zh: 就是如果他们真的到了边境，看看等待他们的是什么，因为从这个距离来看，这太抽象了。

sentences.en: And if they end up making it all the way to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 如果他们最终一路走到了美国

sentences.zh: 按照他们目前的行进速度，他们到底什么时候才能到达？

sentences.en: Well, it's not clear how many miles they'll be able to cover every day.

sentences.zh: 他们依然会在穿过墨西哥北上的途中。

sentences.en: I'm in the central square of Huicla.
sentences.zh: 我在维克斯拉的中心广场。

sentences.zh: 现在是周二刚过九点半。

sentences.en: And tonight, there's a big rainstorm.
sentences.zh: 今天晚上有一场大暴雨。

sentences.en: And after the storm was over, everyone gathered around a bandshell.
sentences.zh: 暴雨过后，大家都聚集在一个乐队演奏台周围。

sentences.zh: 然后不知在哪个时刻，大家都点燃了蜡烛。

sentences.zh: 他们将手臂高高举起。

sentences.en: Someone lifted a sign into the air that said, for our Melvin Gomez, we love you.

zh_words: 雷杰普·塔伊普·埃尔多安

sentences.en: Now, this incident took place in Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 这次事件发生在伊斯坦布尔。

sentences.en: Therefore, this team of 18 people, their trials,
sentences.zh: 因此，这18人小组的审判，

sentences.en: I'm proposing that their trials be held in Istanbul.
sentences.zh: 我提议他们的审判在伊斯坦布尔举行。

sentences.en: In a highly anticipated speech, Erdogan made clear that he would not accept the Saudi explanation that a rogue operation was behind Khashoggi's assassination.
sentences.zh: 在一次备受瞩目的演讲中，埃尔多安明确表示，他不会接受沙特关于卡舒吉遇刺是一起流氓行径的解释。

sentences.en: Of course, we cannot put the blame on a number of security or intelligence officials for such an incident.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们不能将此类事件归咎于少数安全或情报官员。

sentences.en: It will not satisfy either us or the international community.
sentences.zh: 这既无法令我们满意，也无法令国际社会满意。

sentences.en: Above all, Erdogan's speech made clear that after weeks of leaking details about the assassination to the international media, Turkey intends to keep a spotlight on the case.
sentences.zh: 最重要的是，埃尔多安的演讲表明，在向国际媒体泄露暗杀细节数周后，土耳其打算继续将焦点对准这个案件。

sentences.en: The international conscience will only be satisfied when everyone is held accountable, the executors and the persons or the people who gave the instruction.
sentences.zh: 只有当每个人——行凶者以及下达指令的人或人们——都被追究责任时，国际良知才能得到满足。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是今天的《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》中，我们要为节日期间招待客人做好准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让您的客人宾至如归的技巧。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们对光线很敏感吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean, do they black out to go to sleep?
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是喝到不省人事才睡着。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们对光线有什么要求？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一种非常具体的情况。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症吗，对食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on The New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或您喜欢的任何播客平台上收听《The Wirecutter Show》。
